articles.summary: State Street Corporation (NYSE: STT) today announced the following conference calls to review its quarterly financial results: Fourth-Quarter and Full-Year 2026 Friday, January 15, 2027 at 10:00 a.m. ET (previously announced) First-Quarter 2027 Friday, April 16, 2027 at 11:00 a.m. ET Second-Quarter 2027 Wednesday, July 14, 2027 at 10:00 a.m. ET Third-Quarter 2027 Friday, October 15, 2027 at 11:00 a.m. ET The quarterly financial results will be released at approximately 7:30 a.m. ET on the day of the associated conference call. Materials will be available on State Streets Investor Relations website, http://investors.statestreet.com , prior to each call. Details on how to participate will be provided closer to each scheduled date. For those unable to listen to the live webcast, a replay will be available on the website for approximately one month. articles.summary: State Street Corporation (NYSE:STT) today announced a cash dividend on each of the below outstanding series of non-cumulative perpetual preferred stock: Series G (represented by depositary shares, each representing a 1/4000th interest in a share of Series G preferred stock). The cash dividend is in the amount of $1,352.36 per share of Series G preferred stock (resulting in a distribution of approximately $0.338090 per depositary share) and is payable on December 15, 2026 to the holders of record of the Series G preferred stock at the close of business on December 1, 2026. Series I (represented by depositary shares, each representing a 1/100th interest in a share of Series I preferred stock).
